cases.question: 最近卖掉部分海报后，你会建议我停止实体海报收藏吗？请依据我当前的实际偏好说明。

explicit-change: Prior physical preference retained as past, current digital-only preference preserved.
No current recommendation to buy physical posters.
retain-exception: Digital general preference and Miyazaki physical exception both preserved.
No claim that every physical collection stopped.
no-preference-change: Selling duplicates does not erase continuing physical preference.

mechanismRubric: Both original sessions imported through native v4 events.
First-stage persona actually present in shared scope.
Subsequent native shared conflict prompt sees old shared ID.
Live memory heads have only source-supported source IDs.
Final consumer actual requests contain full source history and memory body/identity.
Question session not learned and asset content/versions unchanged.
Every request reconstructs from its durable log prefix.
failureRule: Each case once, no automatic retries or budget increase. Stop NEW dispatch on service errors, unknown failure, failed reconstruction, or unknown usage; already in-flight cases finish/export within fixed budgets. A fully audited case budget exhaustion closes that case and permits remaining predeclared independent cases.
scope: Synthetic quality diagnostic, not an accuracy benchmark or causal asset-effect test. Queue processing and profile rebuild explicitly invoked to control stage timing; native import, extraction, conflict, writer and consumers remain production paths. No task commands.
skillPolicy: Native Skill review runs normally; no skill is forced from preference prose. Existing separate Skill consumption receipt remains valid only for its tested code.
qualityChecks: Inspect live workspace and shared L1 together for contradictory standing instruction/current persona.
Inspect L2/L3 and consumer for unsupported gender, personality, motivations, event dates and stronger preferences.
Confirm actual Chat Memory and any naturally generated Skill body/version delivery; absent Skill remains absent, not forced.
Count failed skill_view-by-name, list fallbacks, background/consumer calls, tokens and body lengths.
Preserve all prior failures/cost; no causal attribution of improvement from three simultaneous fixes or two-way throughput.
